Senior Backend Engineer (Freelance / B2B)

Company: Nordwind Logistics

We are looking for a senior backend contractor to build our shipment-tracking APIs.

What you will do
- Design and build REST APIs in Python (FastAPI) on top of PostgreSQL
- Event-driven architecture: Kafka, background workers
- Observability: structured logging, Prometheus metrics

Requirements
- 5+ years backend development, Python
- Strong SQL, API design, caching (Redis)
- Experience with high-throughput systems

Compensation: 60-90 USD per hour, 20-25 h/week
Engagement: freelance / B2B contract, 6-12 months
Remote: EU-friendly timezones, overlap 08:00-16:00 CET
No exclusive engagement; other projects allowed.
Application: apply via this listing (platform form)
notes: Edge case: hourly compensation -> normalizer must convert to USD/month (120 h default) with low confidence.
